description: A traditional European residential front entry photographed at dusk or early evening. The house is a classic Central European two-story structure with smooth warm cream or pale beige stucco exterior walls and a dark gray clay tile roof with a steeply pitched dormer. A covered entry porch is supported by square timber posts on stone base piers — the posts are raw or lightly finished natural wood, a rustic warm brown tone. The entry door is a classic panel style in a warm taupe or brownish gray paint, fitted with a glass upper portion showing the interior, a letter slot, and a round door knob. Flanking the door at each side of the porch, the smooth stucco wall glows with warm vertical amber light — two tall cylindrical wall-mounted vertical forms emit a brilliant warm amber up-and-down wash of light that illuminates the stucco warmly on both sides of the door, the light spilling onto the porch ceiling as well. The entry porch floor is tiled in warm gray stone tiles with brick-paver steps leading down to the garden path. The front garden features pink flowering plants at the lower left, small evergreen shrubs, and white flowering ground cover to the right. A large picture window or conservatory extension is visible at the right edge with interior plant life visible. The overall palette is warm cream, natural wood, warm amber light, and a touch of pink garden color. Camera is at standing eye-level, normal lens, centered symmetrical composition looking directly at the front door and porch.
